description: Read public topic changes from the commit-ordered event log. Persist next_cursor and drain has_more pages (even empty ones). No push subscription. Poll at the returned interval, initially 60 seconds.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page/check.

since_activity_revision.description: Deprecated; nonzero legacy values require resynchronization. Use cursor instead.

topic_id.description: UUID of the topic to watch.

name: watch_topic
